name: OVER-DRILLED [BETA 0.5.7]
desc:
Welcome to OVER-DRILLED!

You have one goal, reach The Core. While your mission may be simple, actually getting it done will require a miracle. Luck isn't enough, this game will test you and your teams skills and ability to manage resources under pressure on a dingy drill platform that never stops speeding up.

This game is HARD. Seriously! - We recommend playing in groups of at least 3 people!

The difficulty scales based on player count so it's still possible to play solo, it will just be slower and harder.


This game is only made by 2 people so please be patient with updates!
If you find any bugs or have any issues make sure to let us know!

Patch Notes (condensed for space):
8/21 - Release (0.1.0)
9/12 - 0.4.0: Challenges + New Unlockable Items + Physics Rework
9/25 - 0.5.0: Huge QOL update + New content all around
